ns2:course.label: Basic Toxicology
ns2:course.description: Emphasizes the physiology, biochemistry and pharmacokinetics of absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion of topic compounds, drugs, non-nutrient dietary supplements and other compounds foreign to the body. An introduction to the process of cancer, how foreign compounds can initiate, enhance or prevent the process is also included. Same as CPSC 433, ENVS 480, and VB 549. Prerequisite: MCB 350 or MCB 406, or consent of instructor.
